contea di ritrovamento: Kent (Inghilterra e Galles)
R/ [VENERI] FELICI ; D/ IVLIA MA[MEA AVG]

A Roman silver coin: denarius of Julia Mamea, mother of Emperor Severus Alexander (222-235). RIC no. 351. Reverse inscription: [VENERI] FELICI. Obverse: Diademed and draped bust right. Obverse inscription: IVLIA MA[MEA AVG]. Reverse: Venus standing right, holding sceptre and Cupid. Reverse inscription: [VENERI] FELICI. Mint mark: None. Die axis measurement: 12.00. Dimensions: diameter: 20.07mm; weight: 1.39g
